title: peucedanum orientale
intro: Peucedanum orientale, commonly known as Oriental Parsley or Zeravshan, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum orientale include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
